item.title: Batch Process Images with Photoshop Automation Scripts
item.description: Batch Process Images with Photoshop Automation Scripts Click Window -> Actions in the menu bar (Shortcut: Alt+F9). At the bottom of the tab, click ‘Create New Set’ (New Folder), name it ‘Resize Images’ (you can rename it yourself). Then click ‘Create New Action’ next to it. You’ll see the record button at the bottom turn red. Click File > Open, open one of the images you want to process, modify its size, then click OK. Then ‘Save As’, give it a name, and save.
